summary: The patch addresses the issue of evaluating powers of TensorProduct expressions by modifying the `tensor_product_simp` function. It introduces a new case to handle powers of TensorProduct instances.

issues.description: The patch does not handle all potential cases for powers of TensorProduct expressions. For instance, it does not account for nested TensorProducts or other complex scenarios.
The patch introduces a new conditional check and logic within the `tensor_product_simp` function, which may not align perfectly with the existing coding style or conventions of the SymPy project.
